raw.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Principal Executive Search Recruiter | Global Executive Search & Talent Intelligence - Contract Opportunity


Micron is redefining how the world uses information to enrich life for all. As a global leader in memory and storage solutions, our technology is fundamental to the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, data centers, automotive systems, mobile devices, and the intelligent edge.

Behind every breakthrough is exceptional leadership.


As Micron continues to grow and strengthen its position in the semiconductor industry, we are expanding our internal Executive Search capability to identify, engage, and attract exceptional senior leaders and distinguished technical talent who will help shape our future.


We are seeking an accomplished Principal Executive Search Recruiter to join our Global Executive Search team in a contract This role is intended to provide a pathway to a regular full-time position for a successful incumbent, subject to demonstrated performance, continued business need, required approvals, and applicable employment processes.


This is an opportunity for a sophisticated, highly accomplished hands-on executive search professional who combines the research rigor, market intelligence, advisory capability, and candidate engagement skills of a top-tier retained search consultant with the ownership, agility, and organizational understanding of an experienced in-house executive recruiter.

You will personally lead complex senior-level searches while helping Micron build proactive leadership pipelines and a world-class internal executive search capability.


We are looking for someone equally comfortable developing a global market thesis, conducting original research, mapping organizations and talent ecosystems, approaching a difficult-to-access passive executive, advising senior leaders, assessing candidates, and personally driving a confidential search from initial strategy through successful close.


What You Will Do:


Lead Complex Executive Searches from Strategy Through Close

  • Personally lead end-to-end searches for senior leadership and distinguished technical talent across Director, Senior Director, Vice President, Corporate Vice President, Senior Vice President, Fellow, Senior Fellow, and other strategically important positions.
  • Partner closely with executive hiring leaders, People leaders, and HR partners to understand business strategy, organizational context, leadership challenges, and future capability requirements.
  • Translate those needs into sophisticated search strategies, success profiles, target-market hypotheses, candidate archetypes, and engagement plans.
  • Identify relevant industries, organizations, functions, geographies, leadership profiles, and adjacent talent markets.
  • Personally lead executive candidates throughout the search process, from initial identification and engagement through assessment, interviews, offer negotiation, closing, and transition.
  • Operate effectively across multiple complex and confidential assignments while maintaining exceptional quality, responsiveness, discretion, and candidate care.

Bring Exceptional Research, Sourcing & Talent Intelligence Capabilities

  • Conduct advanced executive research across the global semiconductor and technology ecosystem, including memory, storage, silicon, AI infrastructure, engineering, manufacturing, advanced packaging, equipment, materials, cloud, systems, and adjacent industries.
  • Build sophisticated company, organizational, and talent maps to identify both established executives and emerging leadership talent.
  • Look beyond titles and obvious competitors to understand a leader's actual scope, accomplishments, technical or functional depth, organizational influence, and trajectory.
  • Develop evidence-based market intelligence that helps hiring leaders understand talent availability, competitive dynamics, relevant talent adjacencies, and potential search challenges.
  • Create and maintain proactive pipelines for critical leadership and technical talent ahead of immediate hiring demand.
  • Capture market intelligence and organizational knowledge so that every completed search strengthens Micron's future ability to identify and attract exceptional talent.

Find and Engage the Talent Others Cannot

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies to identify executives and technical leaders who may not be readily identifiable through traditional recruiting methods.
  • Leverage professional networks, executive referrals, advanced Boolean search, original research, talent platforms, competitive intelligence, public information, and other approved resources.
  • Construct thoughtful search strategies across direct competitors, adjacent industries, alumni populations, emerging companies, customer and supplier ecosystems, and nontraditional talent pools.
  • Approach highly passive senior talent with personalized, credible outreach that demonstrates genuine understanding of their career and accomplishments.
  • Build relationships with executives who may not be ready to make a move today but could become important future candidates.
  • Maintain long-term relationships with exceptional talent, referrals, prospects, and future succession candidates.

Become a Trusted Talent Advisor to Senior Leaders:

  • Bring an informed perspective to executive hiring discussions rather than simply delivering a predetermined target list.
  • Advise senior leaders on talent markets, competitive dynamics, candidate availability, profile tradeoffs, and search feasibility.
  • Use research and market evidence to challenge assumptions constructively and recommend alternative strategies when appropriate.
  • Lead thoughtful calibration discussions that distinguish essential leadership capabilities from preferences.
  • Provide clear, concise, executive-ready search updates, market landscapes, candidate insights, and recommendations.
  • Communicate with credibility and confidence at senior levels while maintaining a highly responsive and service-oriented approach.
  • Exercise exceptional judgment and discretion when managing confidential searches, potential succession situations, organizational changes, compensation information, and sensitive candidate matters.

Assess Executive Talent with Depth and Rigor

  • Conduct substantive executive conversations that explore leadership accomplishments, business impact, transformation experience, organizational scale, functional or technical depth, enterprise influence, leadership approach, and career motivation.
  • Evaluate candidates based on demonstrated experience, relevant achievement, and alignment with the business outcomes required of the role.
  • Develop insightful candidate briefs that articulate relevant experience, differentiated strengths, potential concerns, open questions, and motivation.
  • Distinguish verified evidence, candidate-provided information, recruiter observations, and areas requiring further validation.
  • Partner with hiring leaders to support structured, consistent, job-relevant candidate assessment and decision-making.

Deliver an Exceptional Executive Candidate Experience

  • Create a highly personalized, discreet, responsive, and professional experience throughout the search process.
  • Serve as a trusted relationship owner and advisor for candidates.
  • Help candidates understand not only the opportunity, but Micron's strategy, technology, leadership environment, culture, and potential for impact.
  • Prepare candidates and hiring leaders for substantive, high-value conversations.
  • Maintain thoughtful communication and follow-through throughout what can be a lengthy executive decision process.
  • Navigate complex considerations involving compensation, equity, relocation, timing, career risk, and other factors that can influence an executive career decision.
  • Partner effectively with Executive Compensation, HR, Global Mobility, Legal, executive support teams, and other stakeholders to create a coordinated candidate experience.

Innovate Through AI & Technology

  • We are looking for an executive recruiter who is excited about how technology can make exceptional recruiters even better.
  • Leverage approved AI and talent intelligence capabilities to accelerate research, company mapping, talent discovery, profile synthesis, outreach development, market analysis, and search reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and AI to reduce administrative work and increase time spent on strategic research, candidate relationships, assessment, and advisory work.
  • Experiment thoughtfully with new research and sourcing methodologies while maintaining appropriate human judgment and accountability.
  • Maintain disciplined data quality, candidate documentation, and market intelligence.
  • Help build reusable research practices, search methodologies, talent maps, and knowledge that strengthen the entire Executive Search function.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant progressive experience in executive search, executive recruiting, talent intelligence, or senior-level talent acquisition.
  • A demonstrated track record of personally leading successful in-house executive searches at the Senior Director, Vice President, C-suite, Fellow/Senior Fellow, or comparable level.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in executive research, direct sourcing, market mapping, passive-candidate engagement, assessment, and closing.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting within semiconductors, hardware, advanced manufacturing, AI, cloud infrastructure, engineering, or another technically sophisticated global industry.
  • Ability to understand complex business and technical requirements and translate them into differentiated search strategies.

Client Location: Israel

What makes this project exciting?

We’re looking for a senior engineer who can build AI native products on top of reliable, secure, high quality data systems. Someone who has experience shipping production level software for high trust workflows, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, can deploy safe agentic systems, and knows how to design robust architecture that scales.

This role is for someone who has shipped production software at scale, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, and knows how to deploy AI systems that are useful, observable, and safe.

You’ll work across the full stack: data ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, product surfaces, AI workflows, agentic systems, and observability.

What makes you a great fit

You have strong production engineering judgment and can move quickly without compromising reliability, data integrity, and security:

● 8+ years building production software

● Strong experience with TypeScript, React, SQL

● Deep backend architecture, API, data modeling, and production debugging skills

● Significant experience with data pipelines, integrations, or data-heavy systems

● Experience building systems that handle sensitive, regulated, and high trust data

● Production experience shipping robust AI/LLM-powered features

● Strong understanding of evals, hallucinations, malformed outputs, retrieval quality, latency, cost, model drift, and provider risk

● Good judgment about when to use an LLM, when to use retrieval, when to improve the data foundation, and when deterministic code is the better answer

● Excellent written and verbal communication in English

● High ownership

AI safety and security:

● You know how to build AI systems that are useful without being reckless.

● You understand prompt injection, permission boundaries, data exfiltration risk, secrets handling, audit logs, and human in the loop review. You treat model context as untrusted input and design agent systems with scoped tools, explicit permissions, logging, evals, and graceful failure modes.

● Security is non-negotiable. You should be comfortable with access control, Postgres RLS, PII handling, secrets management, audit trails, least privilege, secure integrations, and safe use of third-party APIs.

You’ll be especially strong if:

● You have built sturdy data pipelines customer facing products rely on

● You care about data correctness before AI or dashboards depend on it

● You can trace a bad number across ingestion, transformation, database, API, UI, and AI context

● You think naturally in failure modes: stale data, duplicate events, schema drift, partial writes, bad joins, expired tokens, provider outages, and malformed model outputs

● You have worked in high trust data environments such as finance, investment, legal, healthcare, or enterprise saas

● You have experience with Supabase, Postgres RLS, Deno, Modal, embeddings, vector search, transcription, GPU workloads, or similar infrastructure

● You have worked with data validation, reconciliation, lineage, observability, or audit systems

● You have experience with AI evals, AI observability, agent testing, or red-teaming AI systems

Your day-to-day in this position

You will design and ship production-grade systems that combine software engineering, data infrastructure, and AI, including:

● Building secure, scalable full-stack product features

● Designing data models, APIs, integrations, and backend architecture

● Creating reliable data pipelines with strong validation and observability

● Shipping high value high trust AI/LLM-powered features

● Building safe agentic workflows with scoped tools, permissions, logging, evals, and failure handling

● Debugging issues across ingestion, transformation, database, API, UI, and AI context

● Designing systems with security, privacy, auditability, and observability

Job Description

Contracting Legal Professionals (CLP) in Accenture’s Corporate Functions organization coordinate and deliver legal, contract and commercial counsel in support of Accenture's business. This is a pivotal hire as Nutritics embarks on its next transformational step as we continue to scale in the UK & grow into the United States.

As a Senior Customer Engagement Specialist, you will play a key role in delivering a proactive, scalable and high quality customer experience for Nutritics customers across North America.

Working across an assigned customer base, you will combine responsive customer support with proactive engagement to help customers adopt Nutritics effectively and realise ongoing value from the platform. You will monitor customer engagement and usage, identify customers who may require additional support, and take appropriate action or escalate risks where necessary.

As a senior member of the Customer Engagement team, you will also act as a point of support for colleagues, contribute to continuous improvement of our processes and resources, and help shape how we deliver Customer Engagement as our North American customer base grows.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We believe exceptional talent can come from anywhere, and we focus on creating clear expectations, strong team support, and opportunities for professionals to grow while working with high-performing international teams.

For this opportunity, you will support a U.S.-focused personal injury legal team where responsive communication, accurate case screening, and thoughtful client care directly influence whether prospective clients receive the legal help they need.

About the Role

As a Personal Injury Intake Specialist, you will be one of the first people prospective clients speak with after an accident, injury, or difficult personal situation. You will evaluate potential personal injury matters, gather the facts attorneys need to assess each case, and help qualified prospects move smoothly through the intake process.

This is a high-volume role where both speed and empathy matter. You will have clear intake procedures to follow while using your judgment to recognize urgent, complex, or potentially high-value matters that require escalation.

You will work closely with attorneys, case managers, investigators, and other intake professionals while managing your own leads, follow-ups, and documentation. The role is especially well suited to someone who already understands plaintiff-side personal injury intake and wants greater ownership of the prospective-client experience.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients reaching the firm through inbound calls, online inquiries, and referrals.
  • Conduct structured case screenings for motor vehicle accidents, rideshare accidents, premises liability, slip-and-fall incidents, dog bites, and elder abuse or neglect matters.
  • Build a complete initial case picture by gathering incident details, injuries, medical treatment, potential liability, insurance coverage, and other information needed for evaluation.
  • Apply established intake criteria to identify potentially viable, high-value, urgent, or complex matters and escalate them to the appropriate legal team members.
  • Build rapport with prospective clients, communicate with empathy, and explain the intake process clearly during conversations that may involve sensitive or stressful circumstances.
  • Own follow-up with pending leads, obtain missing information, and help qualified prospects progress toward engagement with the firm.
  • Maintain accurate intake records, call logs, case notes, and follow-up activity in Litify while ensuring information is complete and current.
  • Coordinate efficient handoffs to attorneys, case managers, investigators, and other internal teams so qualified cases can move forward without unnecessary delays.
  • Protect confidential client information by following established privacy, documentation, and escalation procedures.
  • Contribute to intake team goals around responsiveness, documentation accuracy, follow-up completion, and prospective-client conversion.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 1-3 years of experience in personal injury intake, legal intake, or a comparable high-volume client intake environment, including direct personal injury intake experience.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. plaintiff-side personal injury matters, including auto accidents, premises liability, slip-and-fall cases, dog bites, and similar claims.
  • Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish, with the ability to conduct sensitive client conversations confidently in both languages.
  • Ability to conduct structured intake interviews, ask effective follow-up questions, and accurately document injuries, treatment, liability, insurance, and incident details.
  • Experience handling a high volume of inbound inquiries and completing timely follow-up with prospective clients.
  • Strong data-entry accuracy, organization, active listening, and professional telephone communication skills.
  • Availability to work an assigned Pacific Time schedule, including potential weekend shifts as part of Monday-Sunday coverage.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Litify, Filevine, PracticePanther, or a comparable legal case management platform; direct Litify experience is especially valuable.
  • Previous experience supporting a California-based personal injury law firm.
  • Familiarity with lead conversion, signed-client acquisition, and intake KPIs such as response time, follow-up completion, accuracy, and conversion.
  • Experience recognizing potentially high-value or time-sensitive personal injury matters for attorney review.
  • Legal studies, related legal training, or familiarity with HIPAA and California privacy requirements.

Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments—no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

  • Domain: Identity and Access Management (IAM) software
  • Location: Israel
  • Company size: 200-500 employees
  • Founded in: 2014

What makes this project exciting?

Are you ready to join a game-changing force in identity and access management?

Our client is revolutionizing the way enterprises protect user identities in a passwordless world. You'll be working at the intersection of cutting-edge biometrics, behavioral analytics, and next-gen identity orchestration - helping the world’s leading brands safeguard millions of users. Backed by more than 100 M Series A - one of the largest in cybersecurity history - and trusted by major global enterprises, they offer the agility of an innovator with the strength and backing of an industry leader.

Ready to take part in redefining IAM for the modern era? Let’s talk.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in security research, mobile security, browser research, fraud research, detection research, reverse engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Experience with web browsers, mobile browsers, WebViews, browser APIs, JavaScript runtime behavior, browser automation, fingerprinting, client-side web security, and low-level browser technologies.
  • Familiarity with the architecture or codebase of modern open-source browsers and rendering engines, such as Chromium, WebKit, Blink, or Gecko, with the ability to reason about how browser internals can expose new security and fraud signals.
  • Experience with native Android and/or iOS applications, mobile OS behavior, app instrumentation, emulators, device spoofing, mobile automation, mobile security, and low-level platform APIs.
  • Attacker mindset and practical understanding of how malicious actors attempt to bypass detection using automation, AI agents, spoofing, and anti-detection techniques.
  • Ability to identify subtle technical signals and turn them into practical detection or data collection opportunities.
  • Experience designing technical experiments and validating research hypotheses.
  • Experience with one or more SDK development languages and environments, such as TypeScript/JavaScript for web, Kotlin/Java for Android, or Swift/Objective-C for iOS, with the ability to understand implementation constraints and collaborate effectively with SDK engineering teams.
  • Scripting ability, preferably in Python, for building research tools, automation, and analysis workflows.
  • Ability to work independently on ambiguous problems and communicate findings clearly to engineering, product, and research stakeholders.

Advantages

  • Experience with Web SDKs, Mobile SDKs, client-side telemetry, device intelligence, behavioral signals, AI agent detection, or fraud detection products.
  • Experience researching bots, credential stuffing, scraping, headless browsers, AI-assisted automation, app cloning, SDK abuse, phishing kits, malware, or
  • anti-detection frameworks.
  • Experience with reverse engineering Android or iOS applications.
  • Familiarity with detection quality measurement, feature evaluation, false-positive analysis, production monitoring, or machine learning concepts.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field— or equivalent hands-on experience.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Research browser, WebView, Android, and iOS environments from an attacker’s perspective.
  • Identify new security signals, behavioral indicators, and technical patterns that can improve fraud, abuse, automation, and AI agent detection.
  • Investigate attacker techniques involving bots, browser automation, AI agents, emulators, device spoofing, hooking, instrumentation, remote access tools, and
  • anti-detection methods.
  • Design and run experiments to compare legitimate, automated, AI-assisted, and manipulated environments.
  • Evaluate proposed signals for reliability, stability, spoofability, privacy sensitivity, performance impact, and production feasibility.
  • Translate research findings into clear SDK feature requirements for web and mobile data collection.
  • Build internal tools, scripts, and lab environments to support signal research and validation.
  • Collaborate with SDK, engineering, product, and detection teams to move research from hypothesis to production.

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

Our next steps

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Intro call with client — ✅ Technical interview — ✅ CTO interview — ✅ HR interview — ✅ Reference check — ✅ Offer

As a Senior Customer Engagement Specialist, you will play a key role in delivering a proactive, scalable and high quality customer experience for Nutritics customers across North America.

Working across an assigned customer base, you will combine responsive customer support with proactive engagement to help customers adopt Nutritics effectively and realise ongoing value from the platform. You will monitor customer engagement and usage, identify customers who may require additional support, and take appropriate action or escalate risks where necessary.

As a senior member of the Customer Engagement team, you will also act as a point of support for colleagues, contribute to continuous improvement of our processes and resources, and help shape how we deliver Customer Engagement as our North American customer base grows.

Main Responsibilities💻
  • Provide timely, professional and empathetic support to customers across agreed channels, including email, phone and live chat.
  • Proactively investigate, replicate, and troubleshoot technical issues reported by customers, collaborating with Product and Engineering to identify root causes and deliver timely solutions.
  • Take ownership of customer queries through to resolution, coordinating with internal teams or escalating where appropriate.
  • Act as a senior point of support for more complex customer queries and situations.

Career Progression and Development🚀
At Nutritics, growth is built into how we operate and we believe that the best way for our business to grow is for our people to grow. As we scale internationally with the backing of private equity investment, we create real opportunities for people to stretch their skills, take on new challenges, and shape the future of our platform and our industry.

  • Experience proactively engaging customers to support product adoption, usage and ongoing engagement.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to take ownership of customer queries through to resolution.
  • The ability to recognise potential customer risk and understand when escalation is required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience within foodservice, hospitality, food technology or SaaS would be advantageous but is not essential.

Most Importantly👍
Nutritics is a people first business scaling at a world class pace, and we are looking for individuals who align with our five core values: Team First, Open Communication, No Ego, Integrity,and The Rocket🚀. We take our mission seriously but don’t take ourselves too seriously, fostering a collaborative spirit where transparency, openness and results are valued over hierarchy. By joining us, you become part of an award winning culture that balances high speed international growth with a genuine commitment to the wellbeing and development of every team member.

About the Role

This role is essential to the successful operation of the Behavioral Health division's contact center, supporting a global, 24/7, multi-channel environment for a fully remote clinical staff. The role combines strategic workforce forecasting and staffing planning with day-to-day oversight of schedule adherence, service levels, and payroll operations, in close coordination with Operations Leadership. It also requires hands-on configuration of Genesys Cloud (WFM/WEM, queue design, and routing) and strong working fluency in the broader platform to support operational needs.

  • Maintain strong working fluency in Genesys Cloud call routing and Architect flows to troubleshoot issues, support IT on changes, and understand downstream impact to staffing and queues

  • Oversee contact center payroll operations, including timecard approvals, PTO, holiday pay, shift differentials, and incentive compensation
  • Resolve payroll exceptions and partner with Payroll, HR, and Operations Leadership to ensure accurate and compliant pay processing
  • Lead, coach, and develop administrative staff, contributing to team communications, engagement, and effective day-to-day operations
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • At least 5 years multi-channel contact center experience

  • Strong analytical skills
  • Self-starter with ability to multi-task and work autonomously
  • Excellent interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite including Microsoft Excel

Other Requirements

  • Consistent and reliable high-speed internet and workspace free from distraction, disruption, or noise is required
  • Ability to be present on camera during work-related trainings, meetings, and/or events

Full benefits package for full-time employees will be provided in accordance with local labor laws and may include:

  • Statutory paid leave and public holidays

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We believe exceptional talent can come from anywhere, and we focus on creating clear expectations, strong team support, and opportunities for professionals to grow while working with high-performing international teams.

For this opportunity, you will support a U.S.-focused personal injury legal team where responsive communication, accurate case screening, and thoughtful client care directly influence whether prospective clients receive the legal help they need.

About the Role

As a Personal Injury Intake Specialist, you will be one of the first people prospective clients speak with after an accident, injury, or difficult personal situation. You will evaluate potential personal injury matters, gather the facts attorneys need to assess each case, and help qualified prospects move smoothly through the intake process.

This is a high-volume role where both speed and empathy matter. You will have clear intake procedures to follow while using your judgment to recognize urgent, complex, or potentially high-value matters that require escalation.

You will work closely with attorneys, case managers, investigators, and other intake professionals while managing your own leads, follow-ups, and documentation. The role is especially well suited to someone who already understands plaintiff-side personal injury intake and wants greater ownership of the prospective-client experience.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients reaching the firm through inbound calls, online inquiries, and referrals.
  • Conduct structured case screenings for motor vehicle accidents, rideshare accidents, premises liability, slip-and-fall incidents, dog bites, and elder abuse or neglect matters.
  • Build a complete initial case picture by gathering incident details, injuries, medical treatment, potential liability, insurance coverage, and other information needed for evaluation.
  • Apply established intake criteria to identify potentially viable, high-value, urgent, or complex matters and escalate them to the appropriate legal team members.
  • Build rapport with prospective clients, communicate with empathy, and explain the intake process clearly during conversations that may involve sensitive or stressful circumstances.
  • Own follow-up with pending leads, obtain missing information, and help qualified prospects progress toward engagement with the firm.
  • Maintain accurate intake records, call logs, case notes, and follow-up activity in Litify while ensuring information is complete and current.
  • Coordinate efficient handoffs to attorneys, case managers, investigators, and other internal teams so qualified cases can move forward without unnecessary delays.
  • Protect confidential client information by following established privacy, documentation, and escalation procedures.
  • Contribute to intake team goals around responsiveness, documentation accuracy, follow-up completion, and prospective-client conversion.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 1-3 years of experience in personal injury intake, legal intake, or a comparable high-volume client intake environment, including direct personal injury intake experience.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. plaintiff-side personal injury matters, including auto accidents, premises liability, slip-and-fall cases, dog bites, and similar claims.
  • Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish, with the ability to conduct sensitive client conversations confidently in both languages.
  • Ability to conduct structured intake interviews, ask effective follow-up questions, and accurately document injuries, treatment, liability, insurance, and incident details.
  • Experience handling a high volume of inbound inquiries and completing timely follow-up with prospective clients.
  • Strong data-entry accuracy, organization, active listening, and professional telephone communication skills.
  • Availability to work an assigned Pacific Time schedule, including potential weekend shifts as part of Monday-Sunday coverage.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Litify, Filevine, PracticePanther, or a comparable legal case management platform; direct Litify experience is especially valuable.
  • Previous experience supporting a California-based personal injury law firm.
  • Familiarity with lead conversion, signed-client acquisition, and intake KPIs such as response time, follow-up completion, accuracy, and conversion.
  • Experience recognizing potentially high-value or time-sensitive personal injury matters for attorney review.
  • Legal studies, related legal training, or familiarity with HIPAA and California privacy requirements.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. For this opportunity, you will support a U.S.-focused personal injury legal team where responsive communication, accurate case screening, and thoughtful client care directly influence whether prospective clients receive the legal help they need.

About the Role

As a Personal Injury Intake Specialist, you will be one of the first people prospective clients speak with after an accident, injury, or difficult personal situation. You will evaluate potential personal injury matters, gather the facts attorneys need to assess each case, and help qualified prospects move smoothly through the intake process.

This is a high-volume role where both speed and empathy matter. You will have clear intake procedures to follow while using your judgment to recognize urgent, complex, or potentially high-value matters that require escalation.

You will work closely with attorneys, case managers, investigators, and other intake professionals while managing your own leads, follow-ups, and documentation. The role is especially well suited to someone who already understands plaintiff-side personal injury intake and wants greater ownership of the prospective-client experience.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients reaching the firm through inbound calls, online inquiries, and referrals.
  • Conduct structured case screenings for motor vehicle accidents, rideshare accidents, premises liability, slip-and-fall incidents, dog bites, and elder abuse or neglect matters.
  • Build a complete initial case picture by gathering incident details, injuries, medical treatment, potential liability, insurance coverage, and other information needed for evaluation.
  • Apply established intake criteria to identify potentially viable, high-value, urgent, or complex matters and escalate them to the appropriate legal team members.
  • Build rapport with prospective clients, communicate with empathy, and explain the intake process clearly during conversations that may involve sensitive or stressful circumstances.
  • Own follow-up with pending leads, obtain missing information, and help qualified prospects progress toward engagement with the firm.
  • Maintain accurate intake records, call logs, case notes, and follow-up activity in Litify while ensuring information is complete and current.
  • Coordinate efficient handoffs to attorneys, case managers, investigators, and other internal teams so qualified cases can move forward without unnecessary delays.
  • Protect confidential client information by following established privacy, documentation, and escalation procedures.
  • Contribute to intake team goals around responsiveness, documentation accuracy, follow-up completion, and prospective-client conversion.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 1-3 years of experience in personal injury intake, legal intake, or a comparable high-volume client intake environment, including direct personal injury intake experience.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. plaintiff-side personal injury matters, including auto accidents, premises liability, slip-and-fall cases, dog bites, and similar claims.
  • Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish, with the ability to conduct sensitive client conversations confidently in both languages.
  • Ability to conduct structured intake interviews, ask effective follow-up questions, and accurately document injuries, treatment, liability, insurance, and incident details.
  • Experience handling a high volume of inbound inquiries and completing timely follow-up with prospective clients.
  • Strong data-entry accuracy, organization, active listening, and professional telephone communication skills.
  • Availability to work an assigned Pacific Time schedule, including potential weekend shifts as part of Monday-Sunday coverage.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Litify, Filevine, PracticePanther, or a comparable legal case management platform; direct Litify experience is especially valuable.
  • Previous experience supporting a California-based personal injury law firm.
  • Familiarity with lead conversion, signed-client acquisition, and intake KPIs such as response time, follow-up completion, accuracy, and conversion.
  • Experience recognizing potentially high-value or time-sensitive personal injury matters for attorney review.
  • Legal studies, related legal training, or familiarity with HIPAA and California privacy requirements.

Opportunity:

DeVry University focuses on developing long-term relationships with superior instructors who have high professional standards, excellent communication skills, enthusiasm and a commitment to providing the finest practitioner-focused education. We are seeking primarily industry professionals to teach and share their knowledge and experience with undergraduate and graduate students in a variety of fields.

  • Courses meet once or twice a week for eight weeks.
  • Face-to-face interaction is blended with technology (such as online discussions and online assignments) for an enhanced learning environment.
  • Faculty are responsible for facilitating student learning by teaching courses and programs in accordance with DeVry University requirements.
  • Faculty develop course syllabi and lesson plans and apply teaching techniques to best achieve course and programmatic objectives.

  • DeVry University does not guarantee any specific number of work hours or assignments, which may vary based on the University’s needs and discretion.
  • As you explore this opportunity, we invite you to view this brief video highlighting how our faculty engage in meaningful student support.

Responsibilities:

  • Develops and provides students with an approved DeVry University syllabus that follows a template established by the local campus, and which includes the terminal course objectives.
  • Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and updates all course materials.
  • Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students.
  • Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning.
  • Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories.
  • Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives.
  • Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams and provides timely feedback to students.
  • Embraces and integrates the responsible use of AI technologies in the classroom to enhance teaching and learning outcomes.
  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize, evaluate, and address appropriate and inappropriate student use of AI tools in academic work.
  • Completes other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • A doctorate in Engineering Technology, Engineering, Applied Engineering, Industrial Technology, or a closely related field is required, with at least 18 graduate credit hours in engineering technology, applied engineering, systems engineering, electronics, manufacturing technology, or related technical disciplines.

◦ Applicants must upload unofficial graduate-level transcripts with their application. ◦ Degrees must be awarded by an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation, or by an international institution determined to hold equivalent accreditation.

  • Three to five years of applied professional experience in engineering technology, technical systems implementation, manufacturing environments, industrial systems, or applied engineering roles.
  • Demonstrated experience with applied engineering technologies and technical systems, including the use of modern tools, instrumentation, automation systems, or engineering technologies used in industry environments.
  • Industry-recognized certifications or professional credentials relevant to engineering technology, industrial systems, automation, or applied technical disciplines.
  • Strong subject matter expertise in applied engineering principles and technical problem-solving, combined with effective communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse learners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry certifications related to engineering technology, industrial automation, manufacturing systems, or applied technical disciplines.
  • Experience with modern engineering technologies, such as automation systems, robotics, instrumentation, computer-aided design, or advanced manufacturing technologies.

  • Experience with industry quality and operational frameworks, including continuous improvement, production management, or technical project management.
  • Experience with programmatic or regional accreditation processes, including outcomes assessment, curriculum alignment, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Two to five years of teaching experience at the post-secondary level, preferably in engineering technology, applied engineering, electronics technology, industrial technology, or related technical disciplines.

raw.description:
US Marketing Lead

Location: United States

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution.

The Role

The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States.

You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working.

You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team.

What You’ll Own

US Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities.

  • Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth.

  • Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market.

  • Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities.

  • Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization.

Demand Generation and Campaigns

  • Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.

  • Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities.

  • Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up.

  • Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement.

  • Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments.

  • Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot.

Sales Enablement

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization.

  • Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets.

  • Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators.

  • Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward.

  • Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities.

  • Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement.

Events, Webinars, and Partnerships

  • Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment.

  • Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline.

  • Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging.

  • Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities.

Content, Customer Stories, and PR

  • Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets.

  • Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators.

  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars.

  • Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships.

  • Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market.

Product Positioning and Market Intelligence

  • Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative.

  • Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process.

  • Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively.

  • Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness.

  • Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership.

  • Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up.

  • Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals.

  • Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth.

  • Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement.

  • Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs.

  • Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies.

  • Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders.

  • Created transparent reporting that shows how US marketing contributes to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in healthcare technology, senior living, or enterprise software industry.

  • Experience owning a regional, vertical, or business-unit marketing strategy.

  • A track record of building integrated campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong sales enablement experience and the ability to work closely with enterprise sales teams.

  • Experience with events, content, email marketing, webinars, account-based marketing, and demand generation.

  • Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and presentation skills.

  • Strong project-management skills and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Comfort working in a fast-growing company where priorities can change and processes are still being built.

  • Strong analytical judgment and experience using marketing and CRM data to make decisions.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and related marketing tools is preferred.

  • Knowledge of the US senior living or healthcare market is highly valuable.

The Person We Think Will Thrive

You are a strong generalist who knows how to turn company goals into focused regional execution. You can write a campaign brief, improve a sales deck, develop an event plan, interview a customer, analyze lead performance, and present a clear recommendation to leadership.

You are commercially minded, comfortable working directly with sales, and focused on producing work that helps the company grow. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process, and you know how to balance brand building with near-term pipeline needs.

The CDW Project Manager is a trusted consultant, providing project management expertise across multiple technology stacks and services. Projects are typically of low to medium complexity and incorporate mainstream, legacy and emerging technologies. The Project Manager may independently manage projects, or work within a large program under the guidance of Program Managers. The successful candidate balances scope, schedules, budget and understands how to leverage PMO tools and templates to drive successful business outcomes for the customer. This position works with mixed teams consisting of CDW engineers, CDW sales, other members of CDW cross functional business areas, customer staff, and third-party consultants. The CDW Project Manager is a project advocate and relationship builder. They drive successful engagements through negotiation, concise communication, crucial conversations, and leadership abilities.


What you will do:


  • Use experience, skillset, and methodologies to understand the client’s end goals and provide a consultative approach to ensure that the solution provided is appropriate for the client’s desired overall outcome and strategy.
  • Be a trusted consultant to your project team in all matters related to project delivery, CDW processes, and project management with best practices and delivery. Build relationships with all project stakeholders.
  • Creates and maintains presence with all project stakeholders, acting as a CDW steward for quality. Dedicated to meeting or exceeding stakeholder expectations. Identifies success criteria and ensures that it is met by involving the stakeholders in key decisions and linking project outcomes to strategic business initiatives.
  • Recognizes the need for negotiations, gathers relevant information, and seeks advice from sales and management when needed. Negotiates changes (cost, scope, effort, schedule of solution, resource commitment, etc.) to agreeable results. Effective negotiation of changes that achieve stakeholder satisfaction and drive positive project results.
  • Works with team members to gather information and determine impacts to the project, document mitigation steps taken in troubleshooting, and communicate these to the team and client.
  • Independently manages medium to large sized projects requiring complex cross functional collaboration and management, adhering to CDW’s project management processes and methodologies.
  • Accountable for project profitability. Track project budgets and resources and manage actuals vs. planned hours against the resource allocation and budget. Timely reporting of project financials and budgets to stakeholders. Ties project outcomes to clients’ business strategies, helping to generate new business.
  • Ensures that time, expenses, and invoices are accurately tracked and approved against the project in a timely manner.
  • Validates initial project scope and estimates. Determine the need for a new Statement of Work versus a Change Order. Makes sellers aware of new opportunities for additional services opportunities uncovered during project delivery.
  • Ensures all items defined in CDW Statement of Work are delivered and perform quality assurance throughout the lifecycle of the project.
  • Establishes, monitors, adjusts and communicates tasks and associated schedules to the project team and modifies when necessary. Build project schedules in conjunction with our engineering teams and partner resources.
  • Aids in identifying proper resources and optimizing billable schedules, monitors and adjusts assignments as necessary to drive client satisfaction and project profitability.
  • Identify, documents, tracks, and communicate project risks and issues. Strategizes potential resolution and drives desired course of action to bring issues to timely resolution.
  • Manages equipment, software, licensing and outside services procurement and delivery schedules.
  • Documents, outcomes, lessons learned and shared appropriately with colleagues. Leverage expertise to help drive business process improvements within the CDW Services PMO.
  • Take accountability for project results and hold all project team members accountable for their scope of work and schedule commitments. Is fiscally responsible to the client, the project and to CDW.
  • Instills trust with our clients by building strong relationships with stakeholders.
  • Uses political savviness, business acumen, and relevant personnel along with CDW experience to establish credibility.
  • Demonstrates the ability to diffuse uncomfortable situations with client and/or project team.
  • Leads teams to consistently meet project success factors and exceed client expectations.
  • Inspects delegated tasks to ensure timely and accurate completion. Coach and mentor Associate Project Managers.
  • Stays abreast of industry best practices through research, conferences, training seminars and participation in professional associations. Shares information across the Services PMO.
  • Determines the appropriate documentation (communication plans, schedules/timelines, status reports, quality plan, closure summary, budget, risk plan, etc.) for projects. Manages the quality and delivery of documentation to clients.
  • Has a clear and concise communication style, leads and facilitates both live and virtual meetings. Keeps meetings on track, on topic and summarizes, assigns and publishes follow up items in a timely manner.
  • Adapts communication style and medium to the audience's needs. Recognizes when communication efforts are ineffective and adapts tactics and/or medium as necessary.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers difficult information. Can credibly communicate complex topics to stakeholders and build consensus.
  • Anticipates client or project needs, communicates potential solutions. Conveys CDW experiences and positive outcomes to build client confidence and trust.
  • Develop and manage a detailed schedule and work plan.

What we expect from you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and 4 years of experience in project management or four years of CDW Services experience OR 8 years of experience in project management or 8 years of CDW Services experience
  • Two or more years of experience in leading small to medium scale projects in a professional services organization.
  • Project management or agile consulting experience as it pertains to advising clients of delivery best practices across multiple technology stacks (e.g., Cloud, Security, Infrastructure)
  • Ability to support presales activities and look for new sales opportunities to help the client achieve organizational goals while growing CDW’s portfolio of work.
  • Participate productively in virtual teams in order to improve Project Management processes.
  • Experience Project Managing projects with several technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to take accountability for projects and their results, be fiscally responsible and lead teams to meet project success factors.
  • Working knowledge of one or more formal project management methodologies, proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Project/Office.
  • Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills including demonstrated experience presenting technology recommendations from a business perspective.
  • Applies discretion when dealing with sensitive/confidential information.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously and adapt to the changing needs of the business while meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to work weekends and/or off hours as necessary to meet clients' needs.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% or as needed to other CDW locations, meetings and client sites.
  • Ability to understand, remember, and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information. Ability to organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology. Ability to multi-task, organize and prioritize. Ability to apply common sense in performing job. Ability to understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines.
  • PMP and/or Agile Certification(s), a plus
  • Experience using both Waterfall and Agile methods (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) to manage projects, a plus
  • Pay range: $77,725 - $108,265 depending on experience and skill set
    Annual bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan
    Benefits overview:
    ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

CDW is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by state and local law.

This is a remote position.

LiDAR Sales Representative

Sensors (LiDAR / Industrial / Robotics / Security Applications)

We are seeking a junior, proactive, and results-driven Sales Representative to help grow our presence across the EMEA and Middle East markets. This role focuses on promoting and selling our cutting-edge LiDAR and sensor solutions for industrial automation, robotics, and security applications.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter based in Germany, passionate about sensor technology, and eager to develop a successful career in international sales.

How will you make an impact?

Market Development & Sales

  • Identify and engage with OEMs, integrators, and distributors in the industrial automation, robotics, and security sectors.
  • Drive new business opportunities and establish relationships with key customers across EMEA and the Middle East.
  • Execute direct sales activities, from lead generation through to closing deals.

Proposal & Account Management

  • Support preparation and delivery of proposals for sensor and LiDAR-based solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with senior team members to develop tailored solutions that meet customer needs.
  • Maintain accurate sales activity and pipeline records using CRM tools.

Channel Partner Development

  • Assist in building and managing a network of distributors and integrators to strengthen the regional presence.
  • Provide product information, training, and sales support to channel partners.

Product Promotion

  • Represent the company at trade fairs, conferences, and customer demonstrations.
  • Deliver engaging product presentations showcasing the value of our LiDAR and sensor technologies.

What qualifications and skills will make you succeed in this role?

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or Business, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1–3 years of sales or business development experience, ideally with exposure to LiDAR, sensors, or automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with industrial, robotics, or security markets is highly beneficial.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong interest and technical understanding of LiDAR and sensor technologies.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages (German, French, Italian, Spanish) are a strong plus.
  • Motivated, organized, and eager to learn within a fast-paced, international environment.

Additional Requirements

  • Located in Germany, with the ability to travel across EMEA and the Middle East as needed.
  • Comfortable working independently while maintaining collaboration with global teams.

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as a liaison between the financial counselors and business office staff and to provide support and leadership to the Intake Department. -

  • Works closely with management team in business office to ensure all internal and external customer service issues are addressed. -

  • Obtain authorizations for all internal services from patient’s PCP and/or managed care companies. -

  • Verify Medicaid patient eligibility status for established patients. -

  • Obtain authorizations for Medipass patients. -

  • Review daily schedules for potential pitfalls of unusual patient insurance coverage limitations or restrictions.

  • Enter all notes and/or insurance changes into the OncoEMR system.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least one year of experience doing insurance verification, billing, and collections in a medical office or hospital setting is required. -

  • Must have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, be very detail-oriented and a self-starter.

SCREENINGS – Background and drug screens

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. In addition, FCS is a drug-free workplace, and all new hires will be subject to drug testing. Medical Marijuana cards are not recognized.

raw.description:
CSQ427R389

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

  • 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
  • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
  • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
  • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
  • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
  • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
  • Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
  • Travel to customers 20% of the time
  • Databricks Certification

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

BenefitsAt Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Automation Network Specialist - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Automation Network Specialist
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.


Job Summary
We are seeking a Automation Network Specialist who blends strong Python development skills with deep networking domain expertise to automate network configuration, change management, and observability across multi-vendor enterprise networks. The role focuses on building production-grade automation using modern network APIs, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD practices that bring software engineering discipline to network operations. The ideal candidate writes idiomatic Python, has shipped network automation in production, and combines networking depth with practical software-engineering rigor. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of network automation experience.
  • Strong Python development skills including OOP, testing, and packaging.
  • Deep networking fundamentals including routing, switching, and BGP.
  • Hands-on experience with Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, or Scrapli.
  • Experience with modern network APIs (NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI).
  • Strong experience with Ansible and Jinja2 templating for network automation.
  • Familiarity with NetBox, Nautobot, or other source-of-truth platforms.
  • Strong Git-based workflows and CI/CD experience.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Cisco DevNet or vendor automation certifications.
  • Experience with multi-vendor networks (Cisco, Arista, Juniper).
