raw.title: Senior Product Designer/Product Manager
raw.excerpt: Hi, I'm Willi, and I lead Product at Modash.  I'm looking for a Senior Product Designer/Product Manager to own the payments experience in our Payments/Creator team.
raw.description:
Hi, I'm Willi, and I lead Product at Modash.

I'm looking for a Senior Product Designer/Product Manager to own the payments experience in our Payments/Creator team.

Background & reason for hiring

Modash helps brands scale creator partnerships on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Brands pay creators in lots of different ways: free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions. Today those are separate flows rather than one coherent experience.

This role is about building one payment experience that handles all of them, on both sides:

  • Brand side - setting up the deal and paying for it
  • Creator side - getting paid

You own the entire workflow end to end. The role combines design and product management in one person: you decide what to build and why, and then you design how it works.

This is what you'll own:

The payments experience

Free products, one-time payments and affiliate commissions, for brands and creators alike, from setting up the deal to the creator getting paid. You work on prototypes and concepts for future iterations, design them, collect feedback and get the requirements ready for engineering.

Running development cycles

  • Prepping user stories and explaining them to the engineers
  • Doing the QA once the work is ready
  • Giving and receiving feedback in retros
  • Deciding when it's good enough to get into customers' hands - it's your product

The customer voice and the story

  • Talking with customers about their pains and needs around paying creators, gifting products and running affiliate programs
  • Keeping everyone in the company up to date on your roadmap, new releases and plans for the next sprints
  • Working closely with product marketing so your product stands out and customers understand what's new
  • Tracking your impact using customer feedback and north star metrics

Your first months in Modash will bring

  • Onboarding with the product and Creator teams on how brands and creators use Modash today
  • Customer calls with brands and creators, plus time in Fullstory and Amplitude to see where the payment flows break down
  • Joining sprint planning with the engineering team and getting to know the backlog

Team structure

You'll report to me (Head of Product) and work closely with a dedicated engineering team lead Besnik. You'll also join a group of talented designer/PMs Renata, Maksym & Heidi who own other parts of our B2B SaaS product, and you'll work with them on product ideas, the shared design system and synced roadmaps.

Requirements

Required skills and experience

  • Experience as both a product designer & product manager or in a hybrid PM/design role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
  • You've written great user stories and communicated your designs clearly to developers
  • You've prioritized work with a bigger goal in mind and built a roadmap yourself. You can explain why some things came first and others didn't make the cut.
  • You've worked with a design system to keep the experience coherent
  • Extreme attention to detail. You notice the wrong spacing, the unclear label and the missing edge case, and you don't ship sloppy work.
  • Get-it-done attitude. We all run into roadblocks every day. We're looking for someone who finds solutions, motivates themselves and keeps getting things done.
  • You're used to, and actually enjoy, a fast pace and constant change in a growing company
  • You aspire to be great. We're not shooting for mediocrity here.
  • Interest in the creator economy. Our mission is to help creators get paid. You don't need to live and breathe the creator world, but we'd like your values to align with ours.
  • You're fluent in English. Our team is spread across many countries, and we work together in English every day.

Nice to haves:

  • UX work on affiliate, marketplace or payments products
  • Strong instincts in research or analytics (you don't need to be an expert in both)
  • Experience with our tools: Figma, Linear, Notion, Amplitude and Fullstory

If you meet most but not all of these, don't let that stop you from applying. We're not looking for a finished product, and we'd be happy to grow with you.

Benefits

What we're offering

  • Fully remote working in Europe 🏠 As long as you have a reliable internet connection, work wherever is best for you. At home, in a café, on a beach. Whatever works.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 65,000€ - 85,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible working hours ⏱ We trust you to do your job without anyone looking over your shoulder. Do your best work whenever it suits you.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you're happy and well rested, you'll do better work. Take the time you need to enjoy a balanced life.
  • Personal development 🧠 When you grow, we benefit. If there's a course, book or conference that will help you upskill, we'll cover it.
  • Ownership 💡 You're the expert at what you do, so you should have the freedom to make decisions and act quickly. No unnecessary red tape. Got an out-of-the-box idea? You'll have the autonomy to try things you might not be able to at other companies.
  • Regular team offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer – PostgreSQL & Kafka on Kubernetes
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to run the PostgreSQL and Apache Kafka platform behind k0rdent-ai — our multi-tenant control plane for enterprise GPU infrastructure.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to run the PostgreSQL and Apache Kafka platform behind k0rdent-ai — our multi-tenant control plane for enterprise GPU infrastructure. Every cluster provisioned, every GPU-hour consumed, and every tenant action is recorded on this platform, so it must be reliable, secure, and recoverable.

This is a hands-on DevOps / SRE role for stateful systems. You will deploy and operate PostgreSQL (CloudNativePG) and Kafka (Strimzi) on Kubernetes using operators, Helm, and GitOps — across cloud and bare-metal clusters, in a global control plane and multiple regions. You will own automation, upgrades, observability, backups, and disaster recovery, and give product teams self-service access to databases and topics through code.

Main Responsibilities

  • Run PostgreSQL and Kafka on Kubernetes: Deploy, upgrade, scale, and operate CloudNativePG and Strimzi clusters with Helm charts and operator custom resources, across cloud and bare-metal Kubernetes.
  • GitOps & Infrastructure as Code: Manage everything declaratively with Argo CD (or Flux), Helm, and Terraform; build CI/CD pipelines for database and Kafka changes, schema migrations, and operator upgrades.
  • High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Design and operate high availability within each region and cross-region disaster recovery — PostgreSQL replica clusters, backups and point-in-time recovery, Kafka MirrorMaker 2 — with defined RPO/RTO targets and regular failover drills.
  • Self-Service Platform: Give product teams self-service provisioning of databases, users, topics, and ACLs through code, with secure defaults and guardrails.
  • Observability & Operations: Build monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for replication lag, backups, consumer lag, and capacity; participate in on-call and lead incident reviews.
  • Security & Multi-Tenancy: Implement TLS/mTLS, secrets management (Vault/OpenBao), network policies, Kafka ACLs, and per-tenant isolation; integrate database and Kafka access with our identity platform (Keycloak / OIDC).
  • Data Movement & CDC: Operate the outbox and change-data-capture pipelines (Debezium, Kafka Connect) that keep databases and event streams consistent between the global control plane and regions.
  • Automation & Tooling: Write automation and small services in Go or Python to remove manual work, and partner with application teams on schema standards and performance troubleshooting.

Must Have

  • Experience: 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years running stateful systems (databases or message streaming) in production.
  • Kubernetes: Strong hands-on Kubernetes operations — StatefulSets, persistent volumes and storage classes, pod disruption budgets, scheduling and affinity, network policies, and cluster upgrades — on cloud and/or bare-metal clusters.
  • Operators & Helm: Production experience running PostgreSQL and/or Kafka through Kubernetes operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, or Crunchy PGO; Strimzi, Confluent for Kubernetes, or similar), and authoring and maintaining Helm charts. Depth with one operator matters more than the specific product.
  • GitOps & IaC: Day-to-day use of Argo CD or Flux, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) in a declarative, review-driven workflow.
  • PostgreSQL Operations: Practical PostgreSQL administration — replication and failover, backup and point-in-time recovery, connection pooling (PgBouncer), version upgrades, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Kafka Operations: Running Kafka in production — brokers, topics and partitions, replication, consumer groups, monitoring, and capacity planning.
  • Reliability & DR: Designing and testing high availability and disaster recovery for stateful systems, with defined RPO/RTO.
  • Automation: Strong scripting and programming in Go (preferred) or Python, plus Bash.

Nice to Have

  • Cross-region replication (CloudNativePG replica clusters, Kafka MirrorMaker 2) and global/regional multi-site architectures.
  • Debezium, Kafka Connect, and transactional outbox / CDC patterns.
  • Identity integration for data platforms (Keycloak, OIDC, LDAP/Active Directory).
  • Observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, VictoriaMetrics).
  • Secrets and security tooling (Vault/OpenBao, cert-manager, mTLS).
  • Bare-metal infrastructure, Ceph or object storage, or GPU/AI infrastructure.
  • Contributions to CloudNativePG, Strimzi, or related open-source projects.
  • Experience in SOC 2 or ISO 27001 environments.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

About fullthrottle.ai

fullthrottle.ai® is an AI-powered advertising operating system that helps mid-market agencies, brands, and media companies build audiences, activate omnichannel advertising, and measure real business outcomes from a single self-service platform. Our AI Media Agent brings audience building, activation, and measurement into one intuitive workflow, so our customers can run sophisticated advertising without enterprise-sized media teams.

We are a fully remote, fast-growing startup. We move quickly, work in an Agile framework, and we make AdTech easy.

About the role

This role is for a workhorse builder who takes features from 0 to 1, voraciously and autonomously.

The Product Manager is a hands-on builder who owns core platform capabilities from prototype to launch and keeps the product operation running underneath them. This is an execution-focused role for someone who would rather build than talk about building, and who uses AI tools as a force multiplier to move faster than a traditional PM.

You will prototype features, write requirements, work shoulder to shoulder with Engineering through delivery and QA, own the operational backbone that keeps the product organization moving, and help hand finished features to Revenue and Marketing so they get adopted and monetized quickly. You will report to the VP of Product, with room to grow as you prove ownership.

What you'll do

  • Build & Prototype (AI-Native): Prototype new tactics, workflows, and AI features to pressure-test ideas, using AI tools daily to spec, mock, and build at warp speed.
  • Scope & Requirements: Write crystal clear requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria that reduce ambiguity for Engineering before development begins.
  • Delivery & QA: Collaborate closely with Engineering through every cycle, and own validation and quality assurance before and after release so features work as designed.
  • Product Operations: Own the day-to-day product administration, including backlog hygiene, roadmap documentation, release coordination, tooling, and status communication.
  • Productization Handoff: Hand finished features to Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing with the context and positioning they need to sell, so new capabilities get monetized quickly.
  • Market & Workflow Intelligence: Research AdTech trends and engage with customers to surface friction and opportunity gaps.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in AdTech, MarTech, product, or digital media platform roles.
  • A builder. You are happiest making things, with a track record of shipping, not just planning.
  • Fluent with AI tools and comfortable using them to prototype, spec, and build. This is a requirement, not a bonus.
  • Strong understanding of programmatic media, including campaign setup, audience targeting, bidding, and performance measurement.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as DSPs, SSPs, CDPs, and ad servers.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized. You can own the operational backbone without being told to.
  • Confident communicator across technical and commercial stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

  • You ship. New capabilities move from prototype to launch on a predictable cadence.
  • The product operation runs cleanly, with backlog, roadmap, and releases organized and current.
  • New tactics and workflow enhancements feel native to the platform, not layered on.
  • Finished features get handed off, adopted, and monetized quickly.

Our Core Principles

We're a team that believes in big ideas and fast execution, adopting a "crawl, walk, run" approach to innovation. We're looking for someone who embodies these principles:

  • Customer Centricity: We always put our customers first.
  • Growth Mindset: We are constantly learning and evolving.
  • Accountability & Integrity: We take ownership and act with honesty.
  • Collaboration & Humility: We work together and value every voice.
  • Open Communication: We believe in transparency and direct feedback.

If you are a builder who loves shipping delightful product, uses AI to move fast, and wants real ownership at a company that is growing quickly, we want to hear from you. This is a chance to make a real, visible impact on the platform thousands of businesses rely on every day.

Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

The Role

You'll be an engineer who builds AI agents in production, sitting close to the customers who depend on them.

This is a full-stack engineering job with an unusually short distance between your code and someone's actual workday. You'll write Go and Python, design schemas, build evals, and present your solution to a senior executive at an enterprise - often in the same week.

What You'll Do

  • Design and ship production agents. You'll build agents that are mission-critical from day one: embedded in Teams, Slack, intranets, voice lines, and email, taking real actions against SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, and a long tail of systems nobody has heard of. These run at enterprise volume under enterprise scrutiny.

  • Own the full lifecycle. Discovery, build, eval, launch, and the unglamorous months afterward where an agent goes from good to genuinely reliable.

  • Work directly with the people whose problem it is. You'll sit with leaders at global enterprises, extract the process from their heads, and decide what should be an agent, what should be a workflow, and what should stay human.

  • Push your work back into the platform. The best patterns you find in the field become part of Ema's core product - new connectors, new agent primitives, new tooling. You'll surface unmet needs and prototype the fix, working with product and platform engineering to make it general.

Example Projects

Recent work by our engineers:

  • Built the orchestration layer for a 200,000+ employee IT services firm spanning 65 countries, unifying HR, IT, and payroll into a single interface across SAP, ServiceNow, and Teams.

  • Rebuilt a recruiting firm's core stack - sourcing, screening, ranked shortlists - cutting time-to-hire by 67% and retiring their legacy ATS along the way.

  • Cut first-response time from two hours to under 90 seconds for an e-commerce logistics platform, including live carrier-site lookups, and held SLAs through peak holiday volume with no temporary hiring.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems, with 5+ years of relevant engineering work

  • Strong backend fundamentals - algorithms, data modeling, and comfort in more than one language, Python and Go especially

  • Proven problem-solving in fast-changing, ambiguous environments where the requirements arrive in a meeting rather than a ticket

  • A builder's mindset and high agency - you find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear

  • Comfort working directly with customers

  • Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike

Even Better

  • You've built or deployed LLM systems in production, and have opinions about evals

  • Familiarity with agent tooling, RAG pipelines, MCP, and prompt engineering as an engineering discipline rather than a trick

  • You've been a founder or founding engineer, and know how to balance craft against speed

  • Experience integrating enterprise applications - HRIS, ITSM, ERP, ticketing - and the authentication that guards them

  • You've worked with distributed, global teams and multi-tenant SaaS environments

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

SKEELO: EMBARQUE NA JORNADA QUE COLOCA A LEITURA NO CENTRO DE TUDO. 🐿️

QUEM SOMOS 💚

O Skeelo é uma plataforma digital de leitura que conecta pessoas a e-books, audiobooks e minibooks em uma experiência acessível e personalizada. Desde 2019, usamos a tecnologia como um meio para democratizar o acesso à leitura e ampliar seu impacto no desenvolvimento das pessoas.

Acreditamos que ler vai além do lazer: é uma ferramenta poderosa para expandir repertórios, fortalecer o pensamento crítico e impulsionar o desenvolvimento humano.

NOSSA VIBE 💚

Estamos distribuídos e distribuídas pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, movidos por inovação, agilidade e aprendizado contínuo, que valoriza a diversidade e transforma a leitura para se adaptar à vida das pessoas. Fazemos tudo isso com transparência nas relações, coragem para inovar, foco em alta performance, olhar constante para encantar clientes e leitores e entregas ágeis que fazem a diferença.

Nosso modelo de trabalho é remote first, tirando o melhor do home office: autorresponsabilidade com autonomia. Porém também acreditamos na conexão e trocas dos encontros presenciais, desse modo, temos alguns encontros presenciais em São Paulo - SP, para conexão com os demais Skeelers. Mas relaxa, o Skeelo sempre organiza tudo pra gente.

O seu dia a dia no Skeelo vai ser assim:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir pipelines de ETL para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados.
  • Atuar diretamente na plataforma Databricks, aplicando boas práticas no dia a dia e contribuindo para sua governança e evolução.
  • Atuar na organização e no catálogo de dados, garantindo qualidade, padronização e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Construir integrações entre diferentes fontes de dados, garantindo qualidade, performance e padronização.
  • Desenvolver soluções em AWS e utilizar o Databricks na construção e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados.
  • Monitorar e evoluir pipelines em produção, garantindo confiabilidade e eficiência dos processos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de Analytics, Produto e Engenharia para atender novas demandas de dados.
  • Garantir que os dados estejam disponíveis com alta qualidade e baixa latência para consumo das áreas da empresa.
  • Contribuir com melhorias na arquitetura, nas boas práticas e na evolução contínua da engenharia de dados.

Para isso, você vai precisar ter:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, desenvolvendo e sustentando pipelines de dados em produção.
  • Experiência prática com Databricks, utilizando a plataforma no dia a dia para desenvolvimento e operação de soluções de dados.
  • Experiência com AWS e processos de ETL.
  • Conhecimento em governança, catálogo e qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, além de ferramentas como Kafka, Kibana e Elasticsearch.
  • Boa comunicação para colaborar com diferentes áreas e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Inglês para leitura e compreensão de documentações técnicas.

E seria muito bom se você também tivesse:

  • Certificação Databricks ou outras certificações relacionadas à plataforma.
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou fintechs de alta escala.
  • Vivência com Data Lakes e arquiteturas modernas de dados.
  • Experiência em ambientes com grande volume de dados.
  • Facilidade para documentar soluções e compartilhar conhecimento com o time.

E os benefícios? A gente cuida bem de quem constrói isso aqui 💚

EnCharge AI is building a new generation of AI compute systems designed to deliver dramatically

higher energy efficiency for AI inference. Our technology combines innovative compute

architectures with a full-stack software platform spanning silicon, firmware, drivers, compilers,

runtimes, and AI model enablement.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager - Embedded Software to drive execution

across our embedded software organization and ensure tight alignment between firmware, drivers,

hardware, architecture, compiler, runtime, and system teams.

About the Role

As Embedded SW TPM, you will be the connective tissue between silicon, platforms and systems

teams, driving the embedded and low-level software programs that enable EN100 (and future

accelerators) to run real AI workloads reliably and efficiently. You'll own the program plan from

architecture through bring-up, pre-/post- silicon validation, and customer/OEM deployment to

surface risks before they become blockers and keeping a hardware-coupled software org moving

in lockstep with silicon milestones.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end program management for embedded software workstreams: device

drivers, firmware, boot-loaders and board support packages for EnCharge accelerators.

  • Build and maintain integrated program schedules that align embedded software milestones

with chip tape-out, silicon bring-up, board bring-up, and customer/OEM delivery dates.

  • Partner closely with embedded software, ASIC/hardware, platform and validation teams to

define scope, sequence dependencies, and track execution against plan.

  • Identify, track, and drive resolution of cross-team risks and blockers (e.g., silicon errata

affecting driver behavior, toolchain dependencies, host OS/driver compatibility).

  • Drive silicon bring-up and platform enablement, including early firmware, boot flows,

device initialization, memory management, command submission, interrupts, power

management, and hardware/software integration.

  • Run the program's operating cadence: planning, standups, milestone reviews,

retrospectives tuned to what a hardware-coupled software team actually needs, not generic

ceremony.

  • Drive execution across geographically distributed engineering teams and external partners

as needed.

  • Help build the program management function like process, tooling, and reporting.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of technical program or project management experience, with a meaningful

portion spent on embedded software, drivers, firmware, or low-level systems software.

  • Direct experience coordinating software programs tightly coupled to hardware (silicon

bring-up, board bring-up, or similar), ideally in AI/ML accelerators, semiconductors,

robotics, or a related hardware-software domain.• Background in Linux kernel driver development processes, JTAG/lab-based debug

workflows, or hardware validation methodologies.

  • Experience with FPGA simulation and emulator environments like Zebu, Veloce,

Palladium.

• Strong understanding of areas such as:

o Embedded firmware

o Device drivers

o SoC/accelerator architecture

o Memory and DMA

o Interrupts and command queues

o Boot and initialization

o Hardware/software interfaces

o Performance and system-level debugging

  • Track record of managing complex, multi-team schedules with hard external dependencies

(tape-out dates, partner deliverables, customer commitments) and keeping them honest.

  • Strong risk management instincts — you find the thing that's going to break the schedule

two months before it does.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to flex between engineering detail and

executive summary.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI accelerators, GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, or other heterogeneous compute

architectures.

  • Experience with silicon bring-up and early hardware/software co-development.
  • Experience with firmware for custom accelerators or SoCs.
  • Experience working across firmware, driver, compiler, and runtime teams.
  • Experience with simulation/emulation environments used for pre-silicon software

development.

  • Experience with Linux kernel, embedded Linux, RTOS, or low-level systems software.
  • Experience managing external engineering partners or vendors.

raw.title: Director of Learning Design
raw.excerpt: About Tergar SchoolsTergar Schools is a Buddhist-inspired K–12 education nonprofit building a new model of learning (MOL).
raw.description:
About Tergar Schools

Tergar Schools is a Buddhist-inspired K–12 education nonprofit building a new model of learning (MOL). We operate a pilot school in Kathmandu, Nepal, and are constructing a larger campus in the Yolmo Valley in the Himalayas.

Our model rests on a simple starting point: every child possesses basic goodness and its qualities of awareness, love, compassion, wisdom, and joy. It is our job as educators to help them recognize this and give them tools to sustain it. Our long-term aspiration is to help form people who are resilient, altruistic, and joyful.

We’re now building the next chapter of that work: a comprehensive, fully secular model designed to weave into any school’s existing life — not just our own campuses. Rather than build more schools ourselves, we intend to reach 100+ schools in 4+ countries within five years by helping other schools, secular or religious, adopt the model as their own.

Why This Role Exists

Our footprint is growing quickly. Two high-performing private schools will begin piloting our model of learning in 2027. A research lab opens in Nepal with a world-class science team. The interest is real and growing.

What we don’t have yet is a full-time position for building the model itself — the products, courses, training materials, and classroom materials that will constitute MOL — and for leading the team that builds it out.

Today that thinking lives mostly with our Executive Director and the instincts of our founding team. This isn’t sustainable at scale. We need someone who can be fully dedicated to this element of our project: an outside-the-box thinker with real contemplative experience, genuinely excited by the challenge of building an entire family of products from scratch rather than adapting an existing portfolio.

The Opportunity

This is a builder’s role. You will not inherit a finished product, a proven training program, or a team. You will build those things — starting hands-on, in the room, with our first two outside partner schools — and then lead the team that takes them to scale.

We have materials. However, none of them is a comprehensive, fully secular contemplative model designed to weave into everything a school already does. That is what you would be building, and there is no template for it.

If you are energized by deciding who you need around you rather than inheriting an org chart, and comfortable being personally in the work now so that later you can hand it to people you have trained this is the position for you. .

What You’ll Own

Building the model

  • Design the teacher training program at the center of the MOL — the core product.
  • Build out the materials that make the training usable in a real school. Today we imagine adaptable toolkits fitted by hand to each school, a playbook for staff and administrators, and family-facing materials. That is a starting hypothesis, not a spec — the process of choosing what comes is yours to lead.
  • Run the model as a product, not a document. Form real hypotheses about what teachers and schools need, test them in live classrooms, and let what you learn change what gets built.
  • Propose what gets built now and what waits — and defend those calls. We hold two commitments at once: build lean, and be the best in the world at this. We call it Minimum Viable Mastery. You are the person who makes that real week to week, not just in principle.

Nailing the first schools

  • Be personally hands-on with our new partner schools in Nepal as they begin onboarding in 2027. You will do this work in tandem with the Executive Director (ED).
  • Use what you learn there to define what a stable first phase actually looks like, and build the real template other schools will follow.

Building your team

  • Decide what team you need, and in what order — a Nepal Country Director and Trainer, Country Coordinators, strategic consultants, instructional designers, a UX researcher, and others as the shape of the work becomes clear (a Head of Training in Nepal is currently being hired).
  • The ED and the Director of Operations (DOO) authorize and execute the actual hiring. The judgment about who and when is yours.

Setting the standard, over time

  • Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche and the ED hold final say on model fidelity today. As you build a track record — likely marked by a completed first onboarding cycle with our two partner schools — that authority shifts substantively to you.
  • Turn Rinpoche’s two to four multi-day sessions a year into material the team can use again: recorded, distilled, built into training, rather than a remarkable conversation nobody can revisit.

Working with the evidence

  • Partner with the research lab opening in Nepal in late 2026 — led by Drs. Richard Davidson, Robert Roeser, and Robin Nusslock — translating what they learn into real product and training decisions.

What’s Yours, and What Isn’t

You own the model and the team you build around you. Three things sit outside that:

  • Fundraising and donor relationships. A separate role entirely.
  • In-country adaptation and community relationships. Local teams own this on the ground, but you liaise with them directly and are in very frequent communication.
  • Hiring mechanics. You decide who you need and when; the DOO handles offers, contracts, and process.

One thing sits in between: production. Instructional designers, visual designers, and media support will eventually build finished materials from your direction. You will not be making them yourself for long — but their quality is still on you.

Who You Are

What we’re really looking for

  • A builder grounded in pedagogy. Deep pedagogical expertise is essential — you understand how children and adults actually learn, and you've designed for it. What sets you apart is that you build and deliver: you've turned that expertise into programs, curricula, or training that real teachers use. A tech or startup background alongside that is a genuine asset.
  • Fluency in a lean approach to product design. You can talk concretely about strategic experiments, problem/solution and product/market fit, and validated learning — and you have actually worked that way, not just read about it.
  • Real, lived contemplative experience. A genuine taste of practice, not necessarily in Tergar’s own lineage, and not merely theoretical familiarity. This is the one non-negotiable that doesn’t bend for the right resume.
  • Comfortable being hands-on first and stepping back later. Personally in the work with our first schools, then deliberately building the standards and training that let a team carry it without you in the room.
  • Able to build lean and aim to be the best in the world at the same time, without treating those as a trade-off.

Experience

  • You bring substantial experience in education — as a teacher, school leader, curriculum developer, or learning designer — and you've built something real from that experience and gotten it into people's hands without much money or staff.
  • Some experience directing, mentoring, or building a team from scratch, since you will be doing exactly that here.
  • Comfort working directly from a founder’s evolving vision rather than a finished brief — you will be co-writing the brief as you go, especially in the first months.

Personal qualities

  • Discernment above all: knowing which calls are yours to make outright and which need to go to the Rinpoche or the ED. This carries more weight here than almost any other quality, because for a long stretch there is no layer of management between your judgment and the model’s integrity.
  • Genuine curiosity about and respect for a tradition that may not be your own, without needing to adopt it as your own practice.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and a mandate that will keep changing shape under you as the first schools teach you things no one currently knows.

How We Work Together

  • Intensive, hands-on time in Nepal during onboarding and the first deployment of the model. Expect three to five months during the first year.
  • Frequent, close contact with the ED for the first six months, settling into a slower rhythm as trust builds.
  • Two to four multi-day sessions a year with Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche, alongside the wider team.
  • A small, distributed, high-autonomy culture across Vermont, Wisconsin, Ireland, Kathmandu, and Minnesota — deep, steady, skillful work over speed.

Compensation & Logistics

  • Full-time
  • Fully remote.
  • Compensation: $75,000–$100,000, DOE
  • Benefits: flexible schedule, unlimited PTO, and health care reimbursement up to $1,000 per month
Salary: $75,000 - $100,000 DOE

TITLE: Program Manager, USDA Advancing Markets for Producers (AMP)

LOCATION: Remote, within the United States

DEPARTMENT: The Wallace Center

This role will be fully remote, however, preference will be given for applicants residing in: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Washington DC, Wisconsin.

Winrock International is a nonprofit organization that works with people in the United States and around the world to empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity, and sustain natural resources. Winrock matches innovative approaches in agriculture, natural resources management, clean energy, and leadership development with the unique needs of its partners. By linking local individuals and communities with new ideas and technology, Winrock is increasing long-term productivity, equity, and responsible resource management to benefit the poor and disadvantaged of the world. The Wallace Center is a unit of Winrock International working to advance a more regenerative, equitable and resilient U.S. food system.

BACKGROUND:

The Wallace Center at Winrock International works to bring together diverse people and ideas to co-create solutions that build healthy farms, equitable economies, and resilient food systems. We envision a future where all communities have the power to nourish themselves and regenerate ecosystems through just food and agricultural systems.

DESCRIPTION:

The Wallace Center is recruiting a full-time Program Manager for its U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Advancing Markets for Producers project. The project supports the production and marketing of conservation-grown rice, primarily in Arkansas and Missouri, through providing voluntary incentives to U.S. growers to implement improved practices. Riceland Foods is a key partner.

Essential responsibilities will include:

Program Management

  • Working in close cooperation with the Project Lead and other staff and Winrock support units (Awards Management, Procurement, Human Resources, Information and Communications Technology, and Finance) to provide management, administrative oversight, and leadership to achieve outcomes of the project.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, responsive, self-directed and able to connect individual projects and decisions to broader programmatic vision and ultimate impacts.
  • Tracking project activities and progress against targets and goals. Ensures accuracy, quality, and timeliness of mandatory deliverables and collaborates in production and approval of final deliverables. ·
  • Demonstrating creativity, initiative and resourcefulness in problem solving and idea generation.
  • Significantly contributing to project management across the program, including updating, analyzing, and enhancing project management tools. ·
  • Supporting the preparation of work plans, reports, working budgets, budget forecasts, implementing project planning and analyzing project successes to build on lessons learned.

Administration and Implementation

  • Complying with organizational processes and policies to ensure compliance and alignment.
  • Ensuring Winrock and USDA specific policies and practices are followed and provide guidance on relevant rules and regulations.
  • Contributing to other team efforts as needed.
  • Completing other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Content and Metrics

  • Ensuring the project achieves its stated project outputs and outcomes, and the supporting data is accurately reflected in the USDA Detailed Project Reporting (DPR) spreadsheet and other reporting mechanisms.
  • Contributing to monitoring and evaluation by reviewing and approving assigned producer and partner information and documentation. ·
  • Contributing to outreach, by writing content, giving presentations, or participating in other aways to highlight activities, important relationships, and impacts of the project.

Leadership and Representation ·

  • Traveling to field sites to assist team members and partners with technical and operational management and implementation.
  • Contributing substantially to Winrock’s reporting to USDA.
  • Managing partner relationships, including sub-awardees, to ensure they are positive and productive and compliant with USDA rules and regulations and reporting requirements.
  • Contributing to new business development efforts
  • Potential supervision of staff

The Program Manager is a motivated candidate who is talented at multitasking in a fast-paced nonprofit environment. This individual should have the focus to handle many complex, evolving responsibilities with a high degree of autonomy, accountability, and attention to detail. This includes engaging in relationships with a range of stakeholders and partners in the domestic agriculture sector. Experience with large U.S. agriculture and supply chain projects is preferred.

EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION

  • Demonstrated Work Experience o Must have a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrates technical knowledge of relevant thematic topics and thought leadership in a relevant subject area (e.g conservation agriculture, rice value chain, agriculture premiums or incentives).
  • Experience with federal government awards - ideally experience with USDA projects focused on U.S. agriculture systems
  • Experience working with U.S. farmer groups
  • A demonstrated knowledge of NRCS practices

· Education

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree is required or combination of relevant experience and education.

· Technical/Computer Skills

  • Ability to demonstrate the highest level of ethical standards at all times.
  • Effective use of Microsoft Office and other technologies essential to doing business.
  • Demonstrated skills in project management to achieve targets within scope, budget, and on time.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills for project management, donor and partner relations, and new business development.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, manage multiple demands, and work under pressure while ensuring quality.
  • Strong individual time management and organizational abilities for completing detailed administrative, communications, and other assigned tasks.
  • High-level cultural competency and ability to work with a broad range of partners and participants respectfully and productively.
  • Comfortable working in a flexible, high-paced environment; able to work well in teams
  • Ability to lead and motivate staff.

· Required Travel

  • Willingness to travel domestically, approximately 2-4 trips per year.

· Communication Skills

  • Fluent English is required.

SALARY/BENEFITS: The salary range is $80,000 - $90,000 and will be commensurate with experience and/or level of education. Winrock offers competitive pay and an excellent benefits package.

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Please submit a resume and cover letter by October 23, 2026.

Winrock is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all people and value diversity and inclusiveness. Winrock recruits, employs, trains, promotes, and compensates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law.

Winrock knows that its success comes from the hard work and steadfast dedication of its diverse workforce. Winrock remains committed to maintaining diversity, inclusion and equity across the entire organization.  

No phone calls, please. Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted by email.

Winrock offers competitive pay and an excellent benefits package.

Winrock is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by law.

At Winrock we have a clear mission: Empower the disadvantaged, increase economic opportunity and sustain natural resources through unwavering dedication to accountability, equity, innovation, integrity and transformation.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreAt Apptegy, we are more than a tech company; we are partners dedicated to transforming how schools communicate and shape the future of education.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Apptegy, we are more than a tech company; we are partners dedicated to transforming how schools communicate and shape the future of education. Your work here will directly empower districts to share their stories, engage their communities, and celebrate student success. We're a team of thoughtful, high-performing individuals committed to making a tangible impact. If you're looking for a dynamic environment where you'll be supported with exceptional mentorship and resources to grow your career, come build with us.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager, Mobile, you’ll own the product direction for Apptegy’s School App and Staff App, two of the primary ways families and school staff connect with their districts.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Client Experience to create intuitive, reliable mobile experiences for diverse school communities.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, technical clarity, customer outcomes, and delivery excellence. District configurations can vary based on package, organizational structure, and user role. You’ll help turn complex and sometimes undocumented behavior into precise, testable specifications so product decisions are clear, consistent, and verifiable.

You’ll also help close the gap between completed code and software in users’ hands. That includes navigating app store review, release hardening, staged rollouts, and version fragmentation while helping the team advance AI-assisted workflows across the delivery pipeline.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the roadmap, prioritization, and sequencing for the School App and Staff App, including where the products should evolve together and where they require distinct strategies.
  • Turn configuration, entitlement, and role-based behavior into clear specifications that engineers, designers, QA partners, and AI tools can execute and verify.
  • Build a deep understanding of school districts, educators, students, families, and staff, and translate those insights into meaningful mobile experiences.
  • Lead product discovery by combining customer research, product analytics, feedback, market context, and business impact.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design from early concept through launch, balancing customer value, product quality, technical feasibility, and delivery speed.
  • Own the product considerations associated with mobile release mechanics, including app store review, release hardening, staged rollouts, and version fragmentation.
  • Bring mobile constraints into cross-functional planning early so teams can set realistic timelines and make informed product decisions.
  • Advance AI-assisted delivery practices by writing specifications that AI agents can execute against and helping the team use CI to generate and verify acceptance criteria.
  • Define success metrics and monitor product performance across activation, engagement, retention, adoption, satisfaction, and app store ratings.
  • Create effective customer feedback and learning loops that continuously improve the mobile experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • Significant experience leading product for native iOS and Android applications through multiple release cycles. This role requires more than responsive web experience.
  • Experience owning product for multiple teams with distinct roadmaps and a shared platform.
  • Experience leading product through significant technical change, such as a re-platform, architectural migration, or modernization effort, while continuing to deliver for customers.
  • The ability to write product specifications that are precise enough to be executed and verified by an engineer, QA partner, or AI agent.
  • Practical experience using AI in the delivery pipeline, such as generating acceptance criteria, deriving behavior from an existing codebase, or automating parts of review. You understand the importance of evaluating AI output rather than accepting it without review.
  • A strong understanding of CI/CD and mobile release mechanics, including build pipelines, feature flags, automated testing, phased rollouts, and version management.
  • Analytical self-sufficiency, including the ability to write queries, interpret product analytics, and use data to make product decisions.
  • Clear communication and strong influence across technical, creative, commercial, and executive audiences.
  • Sound judgment regarding responsible AI use, including privacy, security, accuracy, transparency, and human oversight.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Engineering and Design in an agile product development environment.
  • A commitment to designing intuitive, accessible, and reliable experiences for diverse school communities.

We know strong candidates may not meet every qualification listed. If you bring meaningful mobile product leadership, sound judgment, and a strong desire to build products that matter, we encourage you to apply.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building products for K-12 education, public-sector organizations, communication platforms, SaaS, or other mission-driven environments.
  • Experience owning products used by multiple audiences, including administrators, educators, students, families, and community members.
  • Product-side experience with cross-platform mobile frameworks.
  • Deep familiarity with the iOS and Android ecosystems, including app release processes, push notifications, authentication, accessibility, and mobile analytics.
  • Experience treating accessibility as an ongoing product and engineering program, including automated checks in CI.
  • A track record of improving mobile adoption, engagement, retention, or app store ratings through product strategy and execution.
  • Experience conducting customer research with school districts or other complex, distributed organizations.
  • Experience working with distributed or partner engineering teams.
  • A bachelor’s degree in product management, business, technology, education, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • Willingness to travel periodically for customer research, team meetings, company events, or industry conferences.

Compensation Notice: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $140,000–$175,000, depending on qualifications, experience, location, and other job related factors.

California: Apptegy will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with applicable state and local fair chance laws.

Colorado: Application Window Notice September 21 2026 12:00AM CT. If this role is open to hiring in Colorado (as listed on the job posting), the application window will remain open until at least the date and time stated above in Central Time, in compliance with Colorado pay transparency regulations. If this role does not have Colorado listed as a hiring location, no specific application window applies, and the posting may close at any time based on hiring needs.

Massachusetts: Massachusetts Legal Notice. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Why Apptegy

Join a team that’s committed to your success. At Apptegy, we’re passionate about creating an environment where you can do your best work and find true fulfillment. We believe in investing in our people—both professionally and personally—because your well-being drives our collective impact.
US Employee Benefits:
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage
Retirement 401(k) with employer match
Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
Mental Health Reimbursement
Unlimited paid time off, including seasonal (December) company-wide time off
Paid parental and medical leave
MX Employee Benefits:
Private medical insurance for you and your dependents
Life insurance
15 days Aguinaldo
Vales de Despensa

Apptegy champions the thoughtful integration of AI to empower our teams and processes. As we seek to understand your individual capabilities and how you might contribute, we ask that all responses to application questions and during interviews are genuinely your own. Please refrain from using AI generation tools, as our aim is to assess your authentic voice and expertise.
Equal Opportunity Employer

Position :Tolling Senior MS SQL DBA

Location : 9120 Lockwood Blvd, Mechanicsville, VA 23116

Interview : Both Phone and In Person

Job : REMOTE

We are seeking a SQL Server / Cloud DBA to join the Tolling Eng and Ops Team to administer and support SQL Server and cloud databases in the Tolling group; the role also includes help desk and application support responsibilities.

The Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) Information Technology Division (ITD) Tolling group is seeking a SQL Server database / Cloud database administrator to join the Tolling Engineering and Operations Team. The selected candidate will administer and support SQL Server and cloud databases in the Tolling group. Additional help desk and application support responsibilities will be part of rotation with the Tolling team.

The selected candidate has:

  • Expertise working as a SQL Server DBA
  • Expertise working with SQL clustering, mirroring and high availability
  • Experience working with large SQL databases
  • Expertise in writing Transact SQL
  • Experience tuning SQL Server databases
  • Expertise in installing, upgrading, patching and migrating SQL Server databases
  • Experience working on a Windows platform
  • Exposure to SSIS, SSAS, & SSRS
  • Experience working with Azure Cloud

The selected candidate will:

  • Monitor databases to maintain/ensure database uptime and availability.
  • Troubleshoot application/database issues related to connectivity, access, security, etc.
  • Tune long running SQL
  • Review & refine existing database tasks and processes to better align with agency/group priorities.
  • Leverage & utilize O/S scripting utilities in support of database maintenance/diagnosis/support.

About the Role

Are you a detail-oriented professional passionate about cybersecurity and user governance? We are looking for an Access Administrator to act as the primary guardian of our system security, ensuring that sensitive data is protected while empowering our team with the exact access they need to succeed. In this role, you will be the cornerstone of our compliance efforts, translating complex security requirements into streamlined, day-to-day operations.

About the Client

Our partner is a tech company building product engineering across Fintech, iGaming, and Marketing. They turn innovative ideas into high-performing engines and launch them at scale. As their exclusive recruitment partner, we manage their full-cycle talent acquisition.

What You Will Do

  • Manage the User Lifecycle: Oversee the end-to-end management of user accounts, including efficient creation, modification, and deletion to maintain tight security control.
  • Enforce Privilege Standards: Validate and assign appropriate access levels based on specific roles and responsibilities, ensuring adherence to the principle of least privilege.
  • Conduct Security Audits: Lead regular audits of user accounts to proactively identify, track, and eliminate excessive or outdated access rights.
  • Implement Access Policies: Develop and maintain robust access control policies to strengthen the organization's security posture.
  • Monitor System Activity: Continuously track user access activities to detect anomalies and identify potential threats or vulnerabilities.
  • Execute Incident Response: Investigate access control violations, provide prompt resolution, document all incidents, and escalate to cross-functional teams when necessary.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Analyze post-incident data, prepare detailed reports, and propose process enhancements to optimize security workflows.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 1–2 years of hands-on experience in access management, account administration, or information security.
  • Core Knowledge: A strong understanding of access management principles and industry-standard security best practices.
  • Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated experience working with IAM (Identity and Access Management) systems and directory services such as Active Directory, LDAP, or similar.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex security concepts into clear, actionable information for employees at all organizational levels.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve security incidents efficiently.
  • Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Haves):
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
    • Hands-on experience with the Okta access management platform.
    • Familiarity with regulatory standards such as ISO27001, ISO27701, PCI DSS, or GDPR.
    • Experience automating access management tasks via scripting.
    • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, or similar).

What's in It for You

  • True Ownership: You will have the autonomy to influence our security roadmap and make architectural decisions that protect our production environments.
  • Impactful Work: Your work directly safeguards real-money flows and critical financial data, making a tangible difference in the security of our users.
  • Collaborative Culture: Join a cross-functional team of experts in engineering, fraud, and payments who value security and knowledge sharing.
  • Continuous Growth: We invest in your professional development through support for advanced certifications, conference attendance, and research time.

raw.description:
About Seamless

Seamless is building the future of AI-powered sales and revenue technology.

Our platform combines real-time B2B data, artificial intelligence, sales engagement, and automation to help revenue teams find the right buyers, improve contact and company data, personalize outreach, and create pipeline more efficiently.

Seamless brings data and execution together through an integrated platform spanning sales intelligence, prospecting, buyer signals, data enrichment, AI-powered engagement, AI agents, APIs, integrations, and automated workflows. Our technology helps sales and go-to-market teams turn accurate data and actionable insights into more connections, meetings, pipeline, and revenue.

We operate at the intersection of AI, data, automation, and revenue technology, solving complex problems around data quality, accuracy, scale, intelligent workflows, and how businesses identify and engage prospective customers.

As AI continues to transform how companies go to market, Seamless is investing in our platform, data capabilities, AI products, and people to help define the next generation of sales technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Seamless is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Visa sponsorship is not included in our hiring package. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

Why Seamless

Seamless is building the future of AI-powered sales and revenue technology.

Our platform brings together real-time B2B data, artificial intelligence, sales engagement, enrichment, automation, buyer signals, AI agents, APIs, integrations, and workflow capabilities to help revenue teams find the right buyers, improve contact and company data, personalize outreach, create pipeline, and convert more opportunities into revenue.

As a Full Cycle Account Executive at Seamless, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Own meaningful new-business revenue outcomes and directly influence company growth.
  • Sell a platform designed to solve highly relevant sales, data, prospecting, and go-to-market challenges.
  • Build expertise across AI, sales intelligence, data enrichment, sales engagement, automation, and modern revenue workflows.
  • Partner closely with experienced leaders and cross-functional teams across Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Security, IT, Finance, and People.
  • Develop advanced skills in prospecting, discovery, consultative selling, product demonstration, negotiation, forecasting, and executive communication.
  • Work in a fast-paced environment where strong performance, continuous learning, ownership, and collaboration matter.
  • Build a long-term career in SaaS sales, revenue technology, and go-to-market leadership.

The Opportunity

Seamless is hiring a high-performing Account Executive to own the full sales cycle, from targeted prospecting through discovery, tailored product demonstrations, commercial negotiation, closed-won business, and a high-quality customer handoff.

This is a true full-cycle hunter role for a seller who wants direct ownership of pipeline creation and revenue outcomes. You will build relationships with sales leaders, founders, revenue operations, marketing leaders, and other business decision-makers; diagnose their go-to-market challenges; and show how Seamless can help their teams identify the right buyers, improve data quality, personalize outreach, create more pipeline, and close more revenue.

You will succeed in this role if you are energized by a fast-moving, metric-driven sales environment, take pride in creating your own opportunities, and can consistently convert cold outreach into meaningful customer conversations and closed business.

At Seamless, you will have the opportunity to sell a high-impact AI-powered revenue platform, develop elite prospecting and closing capabilities, work alongside ambitious commercial leaders, and build a meaningful career in sales technology.

What You’ll Own

  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline of new-business opportunities through disciplined multi-channel prospecting, including phone, email, social selling, account research, and other approved outreach methods.
  • Own the end-to-end sales process: prospecting, qualification, discovery, demonstration, solution alignment, objection handling, commercial negotiation, close, and customer handoff.
  • Engage sales leaders, founders, revenue operations, marketing leaders, and other stakeholders to understand their go-to-market priorities, sales-process challenges, and data requirements.
  • Deliver high-quality discovery conversations and tailored virtual product demonstrations that connect Seamless capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.
  • Clearly communicate the value of Seamless’s AI-powered sales intelligence, data, engagement, automation, and workflow capabilities.
  • Create and execute account plans for priority prospects, identify relevant buying stakeholders, and build multi-threaded relationships throughout the sales process.
  • Maintain accurate, timely CRM records, activity documentation, opportunity stages, next steps, close dates, and forecasts in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.
  • Consistently meet or exceed assigned pipeline, activity, revenue, and quota expectations.
  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to advance opportunities and support a strong customer experience.
  • Apply feedback quickly through call review, deal coaching, role-play, product training, and continuous improvement.
  • Stay current on Seamless product capabilities, customer use cases, market developments, competitor positioning, and modern sales practices.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means building a reliable self-sourced pipeline, running high-quality discovery and demos, maintaining strong sales-process discipline, and consistently converting qualified opportunities into new revenue.

During your first 90 days, you will:

  • Complete Account Executive onboarding, product training, sales-process certification, and required systems training.
  • Develop proficiency in Seamless’s ideal customer profile, buyer personas, product value proposition, competitive positioning, and outbound sales motion.
  • Build a repeatable outbound prospecting rhythm and create qualified pipeline through self-generated activity.
  • Demonstrate effective discovery, product demonstration, objection handling, commercial negotiation, and CRM forecasting practices.
  • Consistently perform against assigned monthly MRR quota, pipeline-generation, activity, and quality expectations.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of quota-carrying, full-cycle B2B SaaS, technology, sales intelligence, data, or related new-business sales experience.
  • A demonstrated history of achieving or exceeding revenue, pipeline, meeting, activity, or sales targets in a high-accountability environment.
  • Experience generating a meaningful portion of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, including cold calling, email outreach, social selling, research, and follow-up.
  • Experience conducting virtual discovery calls and product demonstrations using video conferencing and screen-sharing tools.
  • Proven ability to manage a sales process from first conversation through commercial negotiation, close, and customer handoff.
  • Ability to clearly articulate your prior quota, performance attainment, average deal size, sales cycle, pipeline-sourcing contribution, and relative team performance.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to tailor a solution to a prospect’s priorities, business challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Experience working in Salesforce or another CRM and using modern sales tools such as Salesloft, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Seamless, or similar technology.
  • Strong organization, follow-through, attention to detail, and forecasting discipline.
  • A coachable, resilient, accountable mindset and the ability to receive direct feedback and apply it rapidly.
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience selling into sales, business development, revenue operations, marketing, founder-led, or executive stakeholders.
  • Experience selling sales technology, B2B data, AI-enabled software, revenue intelligence, prospecting tools, sales engagement, APIs, or workflow-automation products.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, SPICED, Challenger, Sandler, Command of the Message, or comparable discovery and qualification frameworks.
  • Experience succeeding in a high-velocity sales environment with short-to-medium sales cycles and recurring-revenue targets.
  • Consistent Top Performer in your organization. History of ranking in the top half, top quartile, or top tier of a sales organization.
  • Experience with self-sourced pipeline generation in a remote or distributed sales environment.

Benefits

Benefits

At Seamless, we invest in our employees by offering a comprehensive benefits package designed to support health, financial well-being, work-life balance, and professional growth. Eligible employees have access to benefits that currently include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Voluntary supplemental insurance options

  • Paid time off, company holidays, and paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Remote-first work environment
  • Employee discount and perks program
  • Professional development, ongoing learning, coaching, sales enablement, and career-growth opportunities

Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan documents and may be modified by Seamless at any time.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is looking for a dynamic individual to serve as Clinical Admissions Therapist. The Clinical Admissions Therapist will be responsible for meeting with clients upon admission, building rapport, completing biopsychosocial assessments, and establishing treatment needs.

We’re a mission-driven team working to expand access to life-saving behavioral healthcare for people who need it most. Across all departments, we collaborate to deliver meaningful outcomes and build a more connected, effective model of care. If you're inspired by our mission and excited to help transform the behavioral health landscape, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate personable and competent communication skills to develop rapport with clients and referral sources
  • Present programming information in a thorough and supportive manner to help clients gain access to care
  • Complete virtual biopsychosocial assessments for a wide range of ages, including children, teens, young adults, and adults with various mental health concerns
  • Determine appropriateness and fit for virtual intensive outpatient program (IOP) level of care
  • Construct provisional mental health diagnoses utilizing DSM-V criteria
  • Document client information in accordance with regulatory standards using electronic medical record
  • Assign treatment team members and group schedules while informing staff of new admissions
  • Interface with Admissions, Verification of Benefits, Utilization Review, and Clinical teams in facilitating intake
  • Collaborate with referral sources: hospitals, treatment centers, psychiatrists, therapists, and other behavioral health providers upon admission
  • Looking to cover the following shifts to meet the schedules and needs of our clients:
    • Mornings and Afternoons - Must be available 11am - 7pm MT
    • Afternoons and Evenings - Must be available 12pm - 8pm MT
    • Weekends encouraged
    • Will consider alternative availability on individual basis
  • Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Access to reliable technology resources to deliver uninterrupted, confidential, and compliant telehealth services
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality of care

Requirements

  • Experience working with a wide range of ages, including children, teens, young adults, and adults preferred
  • Experience completing behavioral health assessments and admissions preferred
  • Independent licensure in a mental health field required
  • An independent license is preferred, but we’re happy to work with associate-level clinicians who are eager to grow and work toward full licensure.

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Additional Information

The expected base pay for this role will be between $60,000 and $70,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay will be determined on an individualized basis and will be impacted by location and years of experience. Further, base pay is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Charlie Health-sponsored benefits.#li-remote

Based on the nature of this role, you will need to complete several state background checks for clearance to see clients. Florida requires a fingerprint based background check, with more information found here. Please note that the cost for this background check will be paid for in full by Charlie Health.

Our Values

  • Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.
  • Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.
  • Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.

Please do not call our public clinical admissions line in regard to this or any other job posting.

Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. If you are interested in exploring opportunities at Charlie Health, please go directly to our Careers Page: Charlie Health will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. In addition, Charlie Health will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All communications with Charlie Health Talent and People Operations professionals will only be sent from @charliehealth.com email addresses. At Charlie Health, we value being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to cultivate an environment where individuals can be their authentic selves.     - Hand off every meeting with clear context: who, why now, and what was promised

    - Background at an outsourced SDR, appointment-setting or lead generation agency

    - Experience running multichannel cadences across phone, email and LinkedIn

Competitive Pay: Your dedication deserves more than recognition; it deserves compensation that matches your expertise.

Recharge Time: We prioritize your rest with 20 paid vacation days, parental leave, fully covered sick days, and unlimited days off for unexpected needs.
Global Sync: We align with U.S. holidays to keep our global teams in sync.
Memorable Team Experiences: Work hard, play hard — even from a distance. Our online team-building events and all-hands gatherings bring humor, memes, and a lively atmosphere that makes teamwork genuinely fun.
